name: Spider-Man
summary: The superhero who still has to pay rent. Peter Parker, a Queens teen who got a fateful spider bite, swings around New York on homemade webs and carries a lot of guilt.
origin: Spider-Man is the hero who still has to pay rent, and that is exactly why people love him. Stan Lee and Steve Ditko slipped him into Amazing Fantasy #15 in 1962, the final issue of a dying anthology. Peter Parker, a bullied science kid from Queens, gets a bite from a radioactive spider and picks up its proportional strength, speed and agility, can cling to walls, and develops a tingling spider-sense that flags trouble before it lands. He builds his own web-shooters, tries to cash in as a TV act, and lets a thief run right past him. That same thief later kills his Uncle Ben, and Peter learns the lesson that defines him. He became one of the most successful superheroes ever.
powers: Science whiz who built his own web-shooters

storyline.title: With great power
storyline.beat: Bullied teen Peter Parker is bitten by a radioactive spider in Amazing Fantasy #15. He uses his powers for fame, lets a burglar escape, and that same burglar later kills his Uncle Ben, which teaches him responsibility.

storyline.title: Building the rogues
storyline.beat: Stan Lee and Steve Ditko launch The Amazing Spider-Man and create many of his best-known foes, including Doctor Octopus, the Green Goblin and the Sandman.

storyline.title: Mary Jane and Gwen
storyline.beat: John Romita Sr. takes over the art, Mary Jane Watson finally shows her face, and Peter's college life with Gwen Stacy takes centre stage.

storyline.title: Defying the Code
storyline.beat: A three-issue storyline about Harry Osborn's drug abuse is published without the Comics Code seal. The US government had asked Marvel for an anti-drug story, and the episode helped loosen the Code's rules.

storyline.title: The night everything changed
storyline.beat: Gwen Stacy dies during a fight with the Green Goblin, a turning point that made superhero comics more willing to show lasting loss.

storyline.title: Alien suit to Venom
storyline.beat: Peter brings home a black costume from the Secret Wars that turns out to be a living alien. He rejects it, and it later bonds with Eddie Brock to become Venom.

storyline.title: MJ and One More Day
storyline.beat: Peter marries Mary Jane in 1987. Twenty years later, in One More Day, the marriage is erased from history by a deal with the demon Mephisto to save Aunt May.

gossip.text: Publisher Martin Goodman reportedly hated the idea of a spider hero with teen problems, so Stan Lee slipped him into the last issue of a cancelled anthology. It sold so well he got his own series.
Jack Kirby drew an early version of Spider-Man, but Lee thought it looked too heroic. Steve Ditko designed the famous costume.
Spider-Man naturally shoots webs from his body.
gossip.truth: In the comics Peter invented mechanical web-shooters. Organic webs came from the 2002 film, and the comics only tried them later.

gossip.text: Before fighting crime, Peter tried to cash in on his powers as a masked TV entertainer.
Miles Morales debuted in 2011 and starred in Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, which won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature.
Mary Jane was teased for years before her face was finally shown in The Amazing Spider-Man #42 (1966).

quiz.q: In which comic did Spider-Man first appear?
Who killed Uncle Ben in the original story?
quiz.why: The burglar Peter failed to stop later killed Ben.

quiz.q: Who did Peter Parker marry in 1987?
quiz.why: Peter and MJ married in Amazing Spider-Man Annual #21.
Steve Ditko designed the red-and-blue suit.

theme.tagline: Rent is due, rooftops are free.

timeline.title: With great power
timeline.note: Amazing Fantasy #15 introduces Peter Parker in the last issue of a canceled anthology.

timeline.title: His own title
timeline.note: The Amazing Spider-Man #1 launches his ongoing series, with the Fantastic Four as guests.

timeline.title: The classic cartoon
timeline.note: The 1967 Spider-Man animated series gives the world his famous theme song.

timeline.title: The night Gwen Stacy died
timeline.note: Amazing Spider-Man #121 kills Gwen, and the hero fails to save her, a landmark moment.

timeline.title: The black costume
timeline.note: Amazing Spider-Man #252 shows Peter in a new black suit that later proves to be alive.

timeline.title: Marrying Mary Jane
timeline.note: The Amazing Spider-Man Annual #21 holds Peter and MJ's wedding, also staged live at Shea Stadium.

timeline.title: Tobey Maguire's Spider-Man
timeline.note: Sam Raimi's Spider-Man becomes a box-office smash and launches a modern superhero film boom.

timeline.title: Miles Morales debuts
timeline.note: Miles Morales becomes the Ultimate Spider-Man, and later headlines the Spider-Verse films.
